title: Genome-Wide Characterization of the CAMTA Gene Family in Paulownia fortunei and Potential Role of PfCAMTA5 in Salt-Stress Responses.
authors: Cao, Yabing; Sun, He; Liu, Chunyang; Liu, Jie; Cao, Shenquan; Zhao, Zhenli
one_liner_zh: 该文对白花泡桐CAMTA转录因子家族进行全基因组鉴定与盐胁迫表达分析，并辅以分子对接和Y2H验证蛋白互作，虽涉及TF-DNA体系但缺乏结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Calmodulin-binding transcription activator (CAMTA) transcription factors play key roles in plant stress responses, but their functions in Paulownia fortunei remain largely unknown. Here, we identified eight CAMTA family genes in P. fortunei and investigated their structural features, evolutionary relationships, and expression patterns under salt stress. All PfCAMTA proteins contain the conserved CG-1, ANK, and IQ domains, although their gene structures and physicochemical properties differ. Phylogenetic and synteny analyses revealed close paralogous pairs and orthologous relationships with Arabidopsis CAMTAs. Under salt stress, the eight PfCAMTA genes displayed distinct tissue-specific expression patterns, with PfCAMTA5 emerging as the most prominent salt-responsive candidate, showing broad induction across tissues and the highest transcript abundance. Molecular docking and Y2H assays suggested a potential interaction between PfCAMTA5 and the salt-responsive calcium sensor PfCML28. Transient overexpression of PfCAMTA5 in tobacco improved salt tolerance, as reflected by enhanced photosynthesis, higher antioxidant enzyme activities, and reduced membrane damage, and up-regulation of stress-responsive genes. Together, these findings suggest that PfCAMTA5 may play a potential role in salt tolerance and provide a foundation for further investigation of the CAMTA-mediated salt stress regulatory network in P. fortunei.
abstract_zh: 钙调素结合转录激活因子（CAMTA）转录因子在植物胁迫响应中发挥关键作用，但其在泡桐（Paulownia fortunei）中的功能仍 largely 未知。本研究在泡桐中鉴定了八个 CAMTA 家族基因，并研究了其结构特征、进化关系及盐胁迫下的表达模式。所有 PfCAMTA 蛋白均含有保守的 CG-1、ANK 和 IQ 结构域，尽管其基因结构和理化性质存在差异。系统发育和共线性分析揭示了与拟南芥 CAMTA 的紧密旁系同源对和直系同源关系。在盐胁迫下，八个 PfCAMTA 基因表现出不同的组织特异性表达模式，其中 PfCAMTA5 是最显著的盐响应候选基因，在各组织中广泛诱导且转录本丰度最高。分子对接和酵母双杂交（Y2H）实验提示 PfCAMTA5 与盐响应钙传感器 PfCML28 之间存在潜在相互作用。烟草中 PfCAMTA5 的瞬时过表达提高了耐盐性，表现为光合作用增强、抗氧化酶活性升高、膜损伤减少以及胁迫响应基因上调。综合这些发现，PfCAMTA5 可能在耐盐性中发挥潜在作用，并为进一步研究泡桐中 CAMTA 介导的盐胁迫调控网络奠定了基础。
